question: What claim about measure and origin is at stake in presenting this Kaula teaching as ten crores in measure and supremely arisen?
premises: This teaching is identified as Kaula.
It is described as supremely arisen.
It is described as being of the measure of ten crores.
inference: The Kaula teaching is presented here as supremely arisen and vast in measure to the extent of ten crores.
uncertainties: Whether the measure is literal or numerical in a technical sense is not determinable from this verse alone.
plain_english: Indeed, this Kaula teaching is supremely arisen and of the measure of ten crores.
